sourceEvidenceAlgorithms.trackedPathInventorySha256: SHA-256 of exact git ls-files -z bytes.
sourceEvidenceAlgorithms.scriptInventorySha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON for sorted [relative manifest path, script name, script text] rows, ensure_ascii=false.
sourceEvidenceAlgorithms.scriptScope: All tracked package.json files, including fixtures. This is a superset and is not the executable computation census.
sourceEvidenceAlgorithms.goPaths: Tracked paths ending .go or with basename go.work, go.mod, go.sum, go.work.sum.
sourceEvidenceAlgorithms.workingTreeScope: Accepted tracked tree only; untracked/ignored dependencies do not establish a new approved computation.

stable.description:
Treat the modules listed in a `go.work` file as Turborepo packages.

When enabled, Go modules are discovered from the repository-root `go.work` via the Go toolchain and participate in the package graph: they resolve in `--filter` expressions, propagate `--affected`, and appear in `turbo query`. This feature is experimental.

canary.scope: Documentation occurrence only; no unsupported-runtime claim.

availabilityEvidence.limits: Canary documentation absence is not proof of runtime non-support. Non-applicability follows from the absence of a Go workspace in this repository, independent of client support.

correctnessCase: Verify the clean accepted-tree absence census, exact pinned binary identities and schema false default; preserve absent root setting. Do not enable the feature or substitute a synthetic Go task for a repository consumer.
expectedBenefit: Zero current Go-workspace computations or graph edges can benefit; no time saving is claimed.
reopenWhen: A root Go workspace, module, tracked source or actual consumer is introduced.
A client update changes the discovery or applicability contract.
A proposal would enable Go workspace discovery; exact-client positive and negative regression evidence is then required before activation.
otherEcosystems: Existing nested Cargo crates and the photo-face uv project remain in scope for independent reviews.
